verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a local C/C++ inference engine that users run self-hosted on their own hardware, so by design prompts are processed on-device rather than sent to a vendor that could train on them. However, the evidence pack never states a privacy guarantee, a no-telemetry policy, or a no-training commitment. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user data is never collected or used for training, documentation of no telemetry or network calls during inference (the -hf flag implies model downloads), and independent privacy verification.
